title: Cerberus Config (v2)
description: Configuration file for Cerberus, the Tiamat ecosystem service manager. This schema describes the v2 lane: projects + resources + pipelines as first-class concepts, with per-connector resource config.

version.description: Config schema version. Cerberus requires version 2.

projects.description: Logical project groupings for resources and pipelines.

resources.description: Managed resources (local processes, cloud servers, containers, etc.).

BuildConfig.description: Global defaults for build-time behavior. Per-resource and CLI-level overrides take precedence over these defaults.

install_after_build.description: When true, `cerberus resource deploy` runs `make install` after a successful `make build`. Resources can override per-resource via the same key in their config block; CLI flags `--install-after-build` / `--no-install-after-build` override both.

ProjectDef.description: A logical grouping that owns one or more resources.

id.description: The portfolio-wide project slug. Lowercase kebab-case. This is the join key other systems use: it is the Cerberus registry key (equal to `owner`), the Tesseract memory namespace segment, and the agent-setup project-template basename. Choose it once; changing it is a rename across every one of those.

capabilities.description: Portable tags describing what this project is or needs, e.g. [go, launchd, mcp]. Free-form; consumed by the local control plane for filtering and routing.

links.description: Typed pointers from this project to things outside it — its repo, its docs, the org that owns it.

Link.description: A typed pointer from a project to something outside it.

kind.description: The relation. Deliberately free-form, not an enum: a closed vocabulary would need a coordinated schema change in every reader for each new relation. Blessed v1 kinds are repo, docs, pipeline, owned_by, member_of and requires_secret.

target.description: What the link points at. Shape depends on kind: a git URL for repo, a path or URL for docs, an `org:<slug>` reference for owned_by.

ResourceDef.description: A managed resource. The `config` block's shape is connector-specific; see LocalProcessConfig for the local/process variant.

type.description: Resource kind (process, server, container, etc.). 'process' is the only kind with a published config schema today.

connector.description: Connector that owns this resource at runtime.

config.description: Connector-specific configuration. For connector='local' + type='process', see LocalProcessConfig.

depends_on.description: Resource IDs this resource depends on.

LocalProcessConfig.description: Connector-specific config for connector='local' + type='process'. Fields are decoded into internal/connector/local.ProcessSpec.

command.description: Command + arguments to start the process.

build.description: Build command + arguments invoked by `cerberus resource deploy` before apply.

install_after_build.description: Per-resource override of the global build.install_after_build default. Absent = inherit global; true/false = explicit override. CLI --install-after-build / --no-install-after-build beats this.

env_file.description: Path to env file (relative to dir or absolute, ~ expanded).

port.description: TCP port. NEVER set to 0 — omit instead (lsof status detection breaks on port 0).

health.description: Legacy health check URL. Prefer health_check.

max_restart_attempts.description: Cap on consecutive restart attempts. 0 = unbounded.

log_file.description: Override path for the resource's log file.

profiles.description: Profiles this resource belongs to for selective startup.

protected.description: Mark as protected — required for destructive operations to succeed.

mode.description: Runtime strategy. dev_session = supervised in-process; os_service = native supervisor.

run_from.description: Whether the process runs from the workspace or from an installed artifact path.

artifact_path.description: Override path for the installed artifact binary.

install_root.description: Override install root for the resource.

install_work_dir.description: Override per-deploy working tree under install_root.

HealthCheck.description: Health check configuration for a resource.

url.description: URL to poll for health status (expects 2xx).

command.description: Command to run for health check (exit 0 = healthy).

interval.description: How often to run the health check (Go duration).

timeout.description: Timeout for each health check attempt (Go duration).

PipelineDef.description: A multi-step workflow defined in config.

StageDef.description: A single stage within a pipeline.

ActionDef.description: A single action within a stage.
